subject: Quick walkthrough request — marketplace trial readiness
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@zephyrdata.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-05-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace listing inquiry — quick walkthrough?

Hi Soojin,

We noticed Redwood on the CloudMarket listing and I created a trial org yesterday (account: zephyr-data). I’m evaluating inference runtimes to speed up our prototype and wanted a short walkthrough of how Redwood handles model pinning, dedicated pools, and basic cost controls.

Would you have 30 minutes this week for a quick demo and a couple of technical questions? Prefer afternoons PST. If it helps I can share our infra diagram in advance.

Thanks,
Alex Morgan
Staff ML Engineer
Zephyr Data
alex.morgan@zephyrdata.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

P.S. trial org id: zph-7812
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@zephyrdata.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-05-12T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing inquiry — quick walkthrough?

Hi Alex — great to hear (and congrats on the trial). I can take a 30-minute walkthrough and loop in Connor (AE) so we can cover pricing/regions you’ll need.

Proposed times (PST):
- Wed 5/12 3:00–3:30pm
- Thu 5/13 1:00–1:30pm
- Fri 5/14 11:30–12:00pm

Suggested agenda (flexible):
1) Quick context on your workload & priority (5m)
2) Demo: model pinning, routing, and Dedicated basics (15m)
3) Cost levers + next steps (10m)

I attached a one-pager with our quickstart checklist and the intake CSV that helps us prepare. If you already have the infra diagram, please forward it.

Connor — FYI, Zephyr looks like a good fit for a small Dedicated pool; could you own this AE follow-up if we get warm?

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.inference

Attachments: redwood-quickstart-onepager.pdf, marketplace-intake-form.csv

I’m attaching a brief infra diagram (hostname redacted) and a short note on target latency/throughput so you can tailor the demo.

Alex

Alex — 1:30pm PST on Thu 5/13 is confirmed. I sent a calendar invite (should arrive from soojin.calendar@redwood.inference) with a Zoom link and the preliminary agenda.

Agenda (30m):
- 1:30–1:35: introductions & current prototyping goals
- 1:35–1:45: walkthrough: model pinning, routes (hosted vs dedicated), and fallback policies
- 1:45–1:55: cost controls (batching, quantization guidance) + Qs
- 1:55–2:00: next steps & runner-up options

Connor will cover commercial options and follow-up items.

Prep notes for Alex:
- HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/zephyr-data (I linked your trial)
- If you can, drop the infra diagram in reply so we can call out any integration notes ahead of time.

See you Thursday — talk soon.

Best,
